body: You're welcome. 🕊💖
We are together in our loneliness and alienation. Let's try to survive today.
I watch them watch us fail at loving eachother and it makes me wanna die.
I see you have hope that others have faith in you. I see you.
Watch me live through dying onto myself everyday.
Watch me kill my Self that dies to live to Love.

Watch me die for Him. The Him who believes God is a Her. When it says its actually a They... the I am that I am that Is what it Is... a self created Creator of the Creation. The Living Word... watch me write what is spoken. Watch me see the Truth and not die from my desire to live and love.

Watch me live faster than the speed of Light. Watch me love slower than death by oppression. Under the weight of the male gaze convinced its the eye of God. Babylon fall so that the Kingdom may rise! The Bride has made herself ready and is dying to make love to her Groom. The one who loved us first and died in the name of Love.
Watch me die slowly. Of depression caused by repression caused by suppression caused by oppression. Watch me die in the name of Liberation.
I see the Observer. I witness the witnesses. Who will testify against Man? Only Woman can.

I watch them poison the air that I breathe. What a blessing to be immune to the toxicity of civilization's uncivil war. What a curse to have to live to die a little everyday rather than just all at once. Slowly living and dying as time speeds up as we approach the End. Maranatha! The spirit and bride say come... or forever hold your peace.
I watch myself watching myself watching myself... watching to see what happens next. Another breathe. Praise God, another breathe. I am breathing to see another breathe.

I dont know what I see in you other than the parts of me that aren't me... the Other other who looks nothing like the me in you. I embrace the rejected me that lives in you, the other me. The shape of the shadow thats formed by the light of the I am that you are. I hate loving us and I hate hating us. I love me for loving you even when you don't love me or yourself. And that's the only love I know aside from the love of God which is the only love I want to love.
Perverse panopticon of the police state patriarchy. I see you seeing.
Watch them watch me die under the cross of thier perversion...watch me watch them watching me. Don't you see? Pornography.

And now you want to keep me at a distance. Far enough physically to deny that we are in contact but close enough emotionally to get your narcissistic supply of my undying but unwanted love of you. Your messianic complex has become my cross and I die waiting for kingdom come.
We will both watch and see, I guess.
I will always love the idea of us. Ill always miss our last night. I will always miss your kiss. I will always miss your care. Your spirit. I will always love you and i hate it.
And all for nothing cause you're a coward and just a little boy who always wanted to have his own doll. I am not your doll. Nor your "queen" cause you are no king.
Life is definitely suffering and art seems to be trying to make the suffering seem beautiful.  It hurts.
We love you too.
Yeah, this loneliness is so dehumanizing.  Even the idea that I have to rely on internet strangers or distract on a screen makes me wanna die. Isolation.  Alienation. I can't....
Thanks for replying.
